module Vacas
  def self.sprite_texto(lineas, y0, alto = 30, tam = 22, color = nil)
    s = Sprite.new
    s.bitmap = Bitmap.new(640, 480)
    s.bitmap.font.size = tam
    c = color
    if c.nil?
      c = Color.new(210, 200, 180)
    end
    s.bitmap.font.color = c
    y = y0
    for l in lineas
      s.bitmap.draw_text(0, y, 640, alto, l, 1)
      y += alto
    end
    return s
  end
end

# Vigilantes del Acto V: eventos llamados "Vigia A5". Ven cinco casillas en linea recta.
class Game_Event
  def matanza_vigia?
    return false if @erased || @character_name == ""
    return @event.name == "Vigia A5"
  end
  alias matanza_ev_update update
  def update
    matanza_ev_update
    return unless $game_switches[150] && @event.name == "Cripps caza"
    return if @erased || @character_name == "" || moving? || jumping?
    return if $game_system.map_interpreter.running? || $game_temp.message_window_showing
    d = matanza_ruta
    case d
    when 2 then move_down
    when 4 then move_left
    when 6 then move_right
    when 8 then move_up
    end
  end
  # Busqueda en anchura desde el jugador: Cripps conoce su camara.
  def matanza_ruta
    w = $game_map.width
    h = $game_map.height
    px = $game_player.x
    py = $game_player.y
    dist = {}
    dist[px + py * w] = 0
    cola = [[px, py]]
    i = 0
    while i < cola.size
      x = cola[i][0]
      y = cola[i][1]
      i += 1
      d0 = dist[x + y * w]
      for paso in [[0,1],[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1]]
        nx = x + paso[0]
        ny = y + paso[1]
        next if nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= w || ny >= h
        next if dist[nx + ny * w]
        next unless $game_map.passable?(nx, ny, 0)
        dist[nx + ny * w] = d0 + 1
        cola.push([nx, ny])
      end
    end
    mejor = 0
    valor = 9999
    for paso in [[2,0,1],[4,-1,0],[6,1,0],[8,0,-1]]
      v = dist[(@x + paso[1]) + (@y + paso[2]) * w]
      next unless v
      if v < valor
        valor = v
        mejor = paso[0]
      end
    end
    return mejor
  end
end
